# Turn an eBay payout report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free eBay payout to journal converter: proves the transactions add up to the payout, splits item sales, shipping income, sales tax, final value fees, Promoted Listings, store fees, shipping labels and refunds by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
